name: flow_esc_menu_online
description: In a party's match on a server Esc opens the same menu, without Restart, and the match plays on behind it (lockstep cannot wait for one player). Leave to hub says LEAVE_MATCH to the server, whose caretaker takes the seat, and brings me back to the hub in the party.

steps.wait_until: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and Game.sim != null and Game.sim.tick > 30

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Resume', 'Leave to hub'] and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Menu' and node('MenuLine').text == 'The match plays on'
steps.msg: online: Resume and Leave to hub; no Restart
the match plays on behind the plate
the server heard LEAVE_MATCH: the caretaker takes my seat

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').visible and Session.party_code() == 'K7Q4M' and Session.client != null
steps.msg: back in the hub, in the party, on the same connection
